== Hub rework (21 October 2026) ==
Reorganized this hub so that every format on the GEMP format list has its own page and a one-line entry here. Sources: GEMP <code>swccgFormats.json</code> at billbisco/swccg-gemp commit ec48dc19ee12c82d3b0a89aa15a944e7976f82cc (51 formats), plus the PC format pages and forum threads cited on each page.
* New family sections: Open family, Classic family (Classic, Classic (no v-cards), Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)), Legacy, Decipher-era pools (now with the Modified pools and Premiere - JPSD), Original Virtual, current-virtual retro pools, other labeled formats (Jawa, Scavenger, Ewok, Utinni!, Limited Resources, 100 Card), limited (cube, draft, sealed), and casual/testing.
* The GEMP environments section is now a table of all 51 GEMP names, codes and wiki pages.
* Existing sourced text was kept and moved into the matching section. Every ref now has a Preserved copy (swccg.com snapshots captured by the Internet Archive).
* The play.swccg.com format list (<code>/hall/formats/html</code>) needs a login, so it was not read directly. The deployed checkout on the GEMP server is at the same commit and its <code>swccgFormats.json</code> has the same sha256 as the repository file.
* Before this edit the wiki had a page for 21 of the 51 GEMP formats, plus Classic (no v-cards) (Modified) as a section. After it, all 51 have a page.
* Redirects added: Classic No V, Classic No V Modified, Premiere - Death Star II (Ewok), PDS2E, 100 Card Deck Format, Utinni! Format, Limited Resources (format), Premiere - JPSD, Watto's Cube. A copy was saved by mistake at Open (no shields _ no v-cards) and was a redirect to [[Open (no shields / no v-cards)]]. It was deleted on 21 October 2026, and the save script now sends titles exactly as written.
